proposal.explanation: This SystemVerilog module implements a parameterized asynchronous FIFO with AXI-Stream interfaces using Gray-coded pointers for clock domain crossing. Key corrections from previous attempts include: 1) Fixed syntax errors (always_ff syntax, proper begin/end blocks, function syntax). 2) Implemented robust reset synchronization using dual-flop synchronizers for each reset signal crossing clock domains (input_rst -> output_clk domain, output_rst -> input_clk domain) with combined reset signals (input_rst_combined, output_rst_combined) used in all sequential logic sensitivity lists. 3) Correct Gray code pointer synchronization with local combined resets. 4) Proper AXI-Stream handshake logic (tvalid/tready) with registered output data and valid signal. 5) Parameterized Gray code functions (bin2gray, gray2bin) supporting ADDR_WIDTH+1 bits for full/empty detection. 6) Complete, syntactically valid SystemVerilog module structure with proper parameterization.

review.error: Keep the template license, module parameters and ports byte-identical
review.limitation: Directed simulations plus bounded two-state comparison to a historical reference; no unbounded proof or coverage of all parameters. Fixed references are excluded from model prompts.
review.scope: Reset on either side flushes pre-reset traffic. New traffic preserves data, order, TLAST and TUSER across independent clocks.
